enable: AX7_CAPTURE_PROFILE=1 before constructing CaptureClient/service; all other values disable profiling
default: No steady-clock sampling, metric atomics, per-frame profile JSON or diagnostic stderr when disabled; getter returns enabled=false and empty metrics/counters
client_api: Q_PROPERTY QJsonObject transportProfile READ transportProfile; public getter transportProfile() const; signal transportProfileUpdated(const QJsonObject&)
metrics: Fixed counters: calls,total_ns,max_ns. Times are monotonic wall time, not CPU; nested spans are inclusive and must not be summed. Storage is bounded and does not grow with frames.
single_pass_decoder: decoder_mode=single_pass_utf16: base64_materialize retrieves one QString, base64_decode now performs canonical decoding directly from UTF16 in one pass. Legacy base64_canonical has zero calls because no re-encode is performed; exact ASCII/alphabet/length/padding/padbits validation is fused, not omitted. CRC remains separate.
inclusivity: Client preview_verify ends before signal_delivery; signal_delivery includes synchronous Window/Model consumer work. receive_total includes these stages. output_write includes output_poll_wait and scheduler delay. acquire_total includes hardware wait and preview_poll. These are not additive CPU accounting.
service_diagnostics: Only stderr: AX7_CAPTURE_PROFILE followed by compact JSON containing component service|output,phase,profile. Service also includes an output snapshot. At most job-terminal, service-exit and writer-shutdown messages; no per-frame logs. Each <=4096B message uses one nonblocking write; an absent/unread diagnostic consumer can lose diagnostics but cannot stall capture.
client_service_profile: Getter includes service_profile with last service/output component objects. readyReadStandardError parses only bounded <=16384B lines. stop() drains after child wait and emits final transportProfileUpdated, even during Window destruction. An application-lifetime signal connection may keep the final value; never dereference a destroyed Client.
bounds: Only fixed metrics and component snapshots retained; counters cumulative for Client lifetime and each child service lifetime. Reconnection clears prior child stderr/component snapshots.
wide_stdout_pipe: AX7_CAPTURE_WIDE_PIPE=1 explicitly requests262144B on Linux stdout if it is a pipe, before writer startup. Default off. Failure/nonpipe keeps original behavior; no sysctl/permission changes. profile.stdout_pipe reports requested_bytes,before_bytes,after_bytes,errno,queried,is_pipe,resize_attempted. Capacity is not PIPE_BUF atomicity or a guarantee against partial writes/backpressure.
pipe_diagnostics: Output counters add write_syscalls,short_writes,would_block_writes,max_line_bytes; Client counters add max_input_chunk_bytes,input_chunks_le64k,input_chunks_over64k. These are profiling-only observations. FIFO and line bounds remain unchanged.
scope: Diagnostic observations only. No protocol/status semantics, source verification, frame CRC, record validation, preview opt-in or final BIN integrity/publication behavior changes. Probe/source hashes and actual runtime provenance remain required. A timing profile does not establish physical display/touch/sensor validity.
